messages: Hi! I'm Uday, I coach the Milpitas Lions, an under-12 (U12) soccer team in our community league.
We practice on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 5pm.
Our team colors are green and white.
My assistant coach is Priya, and she can't make any games in November.
We have 14 players on the roster this season.
Can you suggest a simple warm-up routine for kids this age?
The referee fee for each game is 40 dollars.
I'm allergic to peanuts, so please make sure there are no peanut snacks at team events.
Our home games are played at Cesar Chavez Park.
What is a good way to keep young players motivated after a loss?
Dana, one of the parents, usually brings the orange slices at halftime.
Our goalkeeper wears number 1 and our captain wears number 7.
How long should a U12 match be, roughly?
We train with cones and small-sided games most weeks.
Our main rival is the San Jose Tigers, and they play their games on Sundays.
The league fee this season was 120 dollars per player.
Can you suggest a fun drill for practicing passing?
We just bought two new match balls, size 4.
One of our defenders is recovering from a sprained ankle.
What should I say to the team before a big game?
The league requires shin guards for every player.
We usually bring a first-aid kit and a cooler of water.
Please remember that I prefer to get reminders by email rather than by text message.
Our season has 12 games in total.
Can you suggest a cool-down stretch for after the game?
A parent offered to keep score on a tablet at games.
We are thinking about printing team banners.
How do I handle a parent who is too loud on the sideline?
The final tournament is held at the end of the season.
Thanks for the help today!
